rewards: Access to Yu'Biusk (with fairy ring code BLQ)
Ability to purchase plain of mud spheres

st.t: Go down to the Lumbridge Castle basement and climb through the hole in the wall. Talk to Kazgar and choose "Can you show me the way to the mines?" Talk to Grubfoot in the Dorgeshuun Mines, right outside the main entrance to Dorgesh-Kaan.
Enter the city of Dorgesh-Kaan.
Head north-west through Dorgesh-Kaan to Oldak's lab and talk to Zanik there.
s: So why have you come to talk to Zanik?
It's just a dream. It doesn't mean anything.
I think it must mean something.

st.t: Enter the Goblin Cave next to the Fishing Guild.
Talk to Zanik and get her to follow you.
Talk to the goblin guard in the northwest of the cave.
Talk to the Makeover Mage southwest of Falador.
s: Can you turn me into a goblin?
I need to slip past some goblin guards.
Can you turn me into a goblin or not?

st.t: Pick some Pharmakos berries from the bushes outside.
Use the pharmakos berries on the unfinished toadflax potion.

r: Inventory space to unequip all your items

st.t: Go back to the Goblin Cave outside the Fishing Guild.
Go to the area outside the temple near the guards.
Pick some black mushrooms.
Use the pestle and mortar on the black mushroom with an empty vial in your inventory to make black dye.
Take off everything you are wearing, then drink the goblin potion. Confirm to become a goblin: your selection doesn't matter.
Talk to the goblin guard to enter the temple. If you want, you can tell them to guess your name until you get one you like. Go down the stairs into the temple if you aren't there yet.
If you don't have goblin mail, search the crate by the temple entrance for some. Use the black dye on the goblin mail and wear it.
Wearing the black goblin mail, pass by the guard to the northeastern room. WARNING: If you teleport away with a full inventory and while wearing the goblin mail, it will be DESTROYED.
Search the crate for a Dorgesh-Kaan sphere.
Talk to Zanik in the cell.
Pass by the guard to leave the northeastern room.
Talk to High Priest Bighead. When prompted, answer in this order: True, False, False.
s: I understand Big High War God.
Big High War God commands it.
Goblins not mighty warriors before he chose us.
Lead goblins to victory over whole world.
Me want to know about Yu'biusk.
Can I talk to old high priests?

st.t: Pass by the guard to the northeastern room again.
Pickpocket a key from the priest.

r: Inventory space to unequip all your items

st.t: Talk to Aggie in Draynor Village.
s: Can you make dyes for me, please?
Can you make black or white dye?

st.t: Go to the Fishing Contest area at Hemenster, just west of the Ranging Guild, and open the gate.
s: I need to catch a Hemenster Whitefish.

st.t: Catch a Hemenster whitefish.
Bring the whitefish and black goblin mail to Aggie.
s: Can you make dyes for me, please?
Could you remove the dye from this goblin mail?

st.t: Return to the Goblin Cave next to the Fishing Guild with all the dyes, the white goblin mail, the Huzamogaarb key, the goblin potion and some combat gear, wearing nothing. At the guards in the north-west of the cave, drink the goblin potion (your selection doesn't matter) and enter the temple.
Equip the white goblin mail and pass by the guard to enter the western room. Pickpocket the priest there for the Saragorgak key.
Use the yellow dye on your goblin mail. It is safe to unequip the goblin mail inside the enclave, you will be thrown out to the center area.
Equip the yellow goblin mail and pass by the guard to enter the north-western room. Pickpocket the priest there for the Yurkolgokh key.
Use the blue dye on your goblin mail. It is safe to unequip the goblin mail inside the enclave, you will be thrown out to the center area.
Equip the blue goblin mail and pass by the guard to enter the eastern room. Pickpocket the priest there for the Ekeleshuun key.
Use the orange dye on your goblin mail. It is safe to unequip the goblin mail inside the enclave, you will be thrown out to the center area.
Equip the orange goblin mail and pass by the guard to enter the south-eastern room. Pickpocket the priest there for the Narogoshuun key.
Use the purple dye on your goblin mail. It is safe to unequip the goblin mail inside the enclave, you will be thrown out to the center area.
Equip the purple goblin mail and pass by the guard to enter the south-western room. Pickpocket the priest there for the Horogothgar key.
Unlock the door using the 6 keys. You may leave to gear up after unlocking it.
Enter the crypt.
Say Snothead's name at the south-west grave.
Defeat Snothead. He attacks using melee. Then talk to Snothead to learn the name of the next priest.
Say Snailfeet's name at the south-east grave.
Defeat Snailfeet. He attacks using melee and range. Then talk to Snailfeet to learn the name of the next priest.
Say Mosschin's name at the north-west grave.
Defeat Mosschin. He attacks using melee and magic. Then talk to Mosschin to learn the name of the next priest.
Say Redeyes's name at the north-east grave.
Defeat Redeyes. He attacks using melee and magic, and lowers your attack, strength, and defence. Then talk to Redeyes to learn the name of the next priest.
Say Strongbones's name at the north grave.
Defeat Strongbones. He attacks using all 3 combat styles, lowers your attack, strength and defence. Ignore the level 29 Skoblins he spawns.
Talk to Strongbones to learn where Yu'biusk is.
Return to Dorgesh-Kaan and speak to Oldak.
Talk to Oldak in his workshop.

Bring a light source. If you have access to fairy rings, travel to AJQ. Otherwise, climb the stairs in south Dorgesh-Kaan, climb up the stairs to the south to enter the Dorgesh-Kaan cave, climb down the ladder to the west and follow the path east. Talk to Oldak near the machine at the fairy ring.
Fix the machine next to Oldak. On its power panel, set the first value to 9, the second to 4 and the third to 1, then confirm.
Watch the cutscene.
Go to the strange box in the north-west of Yu'biusk, open it and watch the cutscene. Quest complete!
